description: Implementation of HttpAuthController class managing HTTP authentication, including challenge handling, token generation, and credential management within the Chromium network stack.

classes.name: HttpAuthController
classes.description: Manages HTTP authentication process including challenge handling, token generation, credential management, and scheme disabling.

methods.name: HttpAuthController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the authentication controller with target, URL, cache, handler factory, and resolver.

methods.name: ~HttpAuthController
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and ending log events.

methods.name: BindToCallingNetLog
methods.description: Associates the controller's log with the caller’s log.

methods.name: MaybeGenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Attempts to generate an authentication token, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: SelectPreemptiveAuth
methods.description: Attempts to preemptively select authentication based on cache and URL.

methods.name: AddAuthorizationHeader
methods.description: Adds the authorization header to the request if auth token is available.

methods.name: HandleAuthChallenge
methods.description: Processes an authentication challenge from server headers, manages handlers and credentials.

methods.name: ResetAuth
methods.description: Resets authentication credentials and updates cache.

methods.name: HaveAuthHandler
methods.description: Checks if an auth handler exists.

methods.name: HaveAuth
methods.description: Checks if valid auth handler and credentials are present.

methods.name: NeedsHTTP11
methods.description: Determines if HTTP/1.1 is needed based on handler.

methods.name: InvalidateCurrentHandler
methods.description: Invalidates current auth handler based on specified action.

methods.name: InvalidateRejectedAuthFromCache
methods.description: Removes failed auth entry from cache.

methods.name: PrepareIdentityForReuse
methods.description: Resets identity state for reuse.

methods.name: SelectNextAuthIdentityToTry
methods.description: Selects next identity to attempt based on URL, cache, or default credentials.

methods.name: PopulateAuthChallenge
methods.description: Fills auth challenge info for client use.

methods.name: HandleGenerateTokenResult
methods.description: Handles result of token generation, invalidates handler on errors.

methods.name: OnGenerateAuthTokenDone
methods.description: Callback for completion of token generation.

methods.name: TakeAuthInfo
methods.description: Transfers auth challenge info.

methods.name: IsAuthSchemeDisabled
methods.description: Checks if an auth scheme is disabled.

methods.name: DisableAuthScheme
methods.description: Disables a specific auth scheme.

methods.name: DisableEmbeddedIdentity
methods.description: Marks embedded identity as used.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles connection closure by invalidating handler.
